raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Reversal rows (status 'REVERSAL', 31 rows) carry orig_txn_id pointing at POSTED originals such as 904133. The silver filter drops the reversal rows but keeps their originals, so the reversed amounts are double-counted in every gold table, most visibly in recent batches. The fix is to exclude any POSTED transaction that a REVERSAL row references, using a NULL-safe NOT EXISTS.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(t.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t WHERE t.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'REVERSAL' AND r.orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL AND r.orig_txn_id = t.txn_id);"}}
